conviction_note: Balanced evidence: an independent Yunhe series shows iQIYI won none of Q3's top-3 dramas and industry top-20 plays fell 27% YoY (negative for the 64%-of-revenue membership line), against an RMB-converted revenue bar of roughly RMB6.17bn that sits below Q2's RMB6.29bn, continued cost cuts and a short position near 14 days to cover. The findings sum to +0.6 while the scaled number is -0.12. The scaled number is lower because the four confirmed earnings reactions I could rebuild were three down and one up (-8.1, -3.4, -1.8, +2.8), so this name has sold its prints; that history pulls p_up to 49 and nothing in the evidence overrides it.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $909M and EPS -$0.01 per ADS. Two sources agree: Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/IQ/earnings-forecasts and Earnings Whispers via Finviz (published 2026-11-09) https://finviz.com/news/419195/iqiyis-ai-pivot-faces-its-breakeven-test-as-revenue-keeps-sliding. The Earnings Whispers whisper is +$0.01. iQIYI gives no numerical guidance (Q2 release: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/iQIYI+Reports+Second+Quarter+2026+Financial+Results). The bar in RMB is an inference. Q2's convenience rate (RMB6.29bn = US$926.6M, about 6.79) puts $909M at about RMB6.17bn, which is -7.6% YoY against Q3 2025's RMB6.68bn and -1.9% QoQ. Earnings Whispers' '-2.6% YoY' compares USD figures across different FX rates. Because the RMB bar is my conversion, findings that depend on it are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 70.55M shares at the 2026-10-30 settlement, 14.08 days to cover, up from 63.58M (10.05 days) on 10-15 and 71.8M (7.69 days) on 09-30. That is 7.31% of 965M shares outstanding. Baidu holds roughly half the shares, so my estimate is about 14% of the free float (source: https://equibles.com/stocks/iq/shortinterest, FINRA settlement 2026-10-30). Days to cover rose mainly because volume fell. MarketBeat on 2026-11-09 put volume 82% below its 8.37M average (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-iqiyi-nasdaq-iq-stock-falls-45-heres-why-2026-11-09/). There is no skew: the option chain is unusable, ATM legs are not two-sided, total open interest is 361 and the put/call OI ratio is 0.05. The tape: spot $0.83, 0.44% above the 52-week low, -13.6% over 5 days, -63% from the 52-week high. This is a crowded, illiquid short into the print, which is a reason to shrink negatives.

findings.finding: Yunhe (Enlightent) Q3 2026 long-drama report (data 2026-07-01 to 09-30): all three dramas above 1bn effective plays went to rivals (Youku's 九门 12.7亿 and 早春晴朗 10.5亿, Tencent's 兰香如故 10.0亿). iQIYI's best exclusives ranked #7 (重器 5.8亿) and #9 (雀骨 5.0亿); its other top-20 entries were shared with Tencent or Youku (这一秒过火 #5, 兵自风中来 #8). Industry TOP20 effective plays fell 27% YoY (145亿 to 106亿) and new long dramas across the big four fell 49%. This points to soft Q3 membership revenue, which was RMB4.21bn in Q3 2025 and RMB4.01bn (-2% YoY) in Q2 2026. Q3 should normally rise seasonally; a weak slate argues flat to down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (Nov 2025) membership fell 4% YoY on a 'lighter content slate' and the stock still rose about 2.75% (baseline row 2025-11-18). Q2 2026 membership fell 2% YoY with a slight revenue miss and the stock fell about 8% (MarketBeat 2026-08-18; baseline -8.13). Reactions on this line are mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: The report has been public since Oct 13 and the stock is down 13.6% in five days to a 52-week low, so this is probably partly priced. If it were fully priced, the consensus would already show a membership decline. The $909M bar (about RMB6.17bn, -7.6% YoY) is consistent with a weak quarter, but no preview names the drama data; the Finviz/Earnings Whispers preview only asks 'whether membership rebounds sequentially'. It is a third-party proxy for iQIYI's membership revenue, not a company number.
findings.independence: Sina/Jiemian coverage of the same Yunhe report (dated 2026-10-19) says the summer season was a cooling period and names no iQIYI title among Q3's top dramas: https://finance.sina.cn/2026-10-19/detail-inivumaf7728617.d.html?vt=4. That is the same underlying data, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: The same Yunhe report shows a structural content-cost shift at iQIYI in Q3 2026. Its share of new domestic dramas carried exclusively fell from 61% to 39% (-22pp, the largest drop of the four platforms). Its share released on revenue-sharing (分账) terms rose from 14% to 39% (+25pp), with 80% of its revenue-share dramas co-broadcast across platforms. New-drama count was steady at 30 against 33. Revenue-share and shared releases cut upfront licensing and amortisation per title. That supports the operating-profit line the market is watching: management said in Q2 the non-GAAP operating loss was 'approaching breakeven', and the whisper is +$0.01 against a -$0.01 consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026, SG&A fell 22% and FCF turned positive (RMB319.6M), yet the stock fell about 8% on the revenue miss and wider net loss. So cost discipline alone has not been rewarded when revenue misses.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews frame Q3 as 'whether losses keep shrinking while revenue declines'. None cites the platform-level exclusivity or revenue-share shift, which is in slide data and not in the English wire. If it were priced, the consensus EPS would sit at or above breakeven rather than at -$0.01. This is an inference from content-release mix to the cost line, not a company number.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1, so the two count as one source. Company commentary pointing the same way: the Q2 2026 call said the non-GAAP operating loss 'narrowed substantially' and is 'approaching breakeven' (https://www.webull.com/news/15423801978012672), and content costs were +1% YoY in Q2 (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/iQIYI+Reports+Second+Quarter+2026+Financial+Results).

findings.finding: The revenue bar in RMB is low against the Q2 run-rate. $909M at Q2's 6.79 convenience rate is about RMB6.17bn, below Q2 2026's RMB6.29bn, although Q3 is seasonally flat to up (Q3 2025 was RMB6.68bn against Q2 2025's RMB6.63bn). The 'other revenue' reset (-58% YoY in Q2, from a changed cooperation arrangement) is already in the Q2 base. My bottom-up range is RMB6.0-6.6bn: membership 4.0-4.15bn, advertising 1.2-1.3bn, content distribution 0.5-0.8bn, other about 0.33bn. Midpoint about RMB6.3bn, about 1.5% above the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue missed by $4M ($923.8M against $927.9M) and the stock fell about 8%. Q3 2025 'beat with narrower losses' and the stock rose about 2.75% to 5%. Revenue surprises have moved this name in the sign of the surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews quote the bar as -2.6% YoY in USD, which compares across different FX rates, so the RMB bar is lower than the headline suggests. If the market read it as -7.6% in RMB, a modest sequential revenue rise would be seen as the base case and the stock would not be at a 52-week low into the print. The FX basis behind the consensus is not confirmed, so this rests on an inference about the bar and is capped small.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 line items from the company release: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/iQIYI+Reports+Second+Quarter+2026+Financial+Results. Q3 2025 line items from the company 6-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1722608/000119312525286142/d35113dex991.htm. The content-distribution windfall that drove Q2 (+56%) could reverse, so the bar call is fragile, and finding 1 (a weak slate) argues against the membership half of it.

findings.finding: Crowded, illiquid short into the print. Short interest is 70.6M shares, 14.08 days to cover (FINRA 2026-10-30), up 11% from mid-October, and about 14% of the non-Baidu float by my estimate. The ADS sits at $0.83, 0.44% above its 52-week low, after -13.6% in five days on volume running about 80% below average. A sub-$1 stock with this short base can gap hard on any print better than feared.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed. Short interest held at 70-72M shares from August through October across the Q2 print, and the Q2 print still fell about 8%, so the short base has not prevented downside before.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is a mechanism, not a fact the price can absorb. Days to cover doubled because liquidity dried up, which raises squeeze convexity on a positive surprise. If the market had already priced this, the sharp 5-day decline would have drawn covering; instead short interest rose.
findings.independence: MarketBeat 2026-11-09 reports volume 82% below average, a 50-day moving average of $0.96 and a 200-day of $1.24: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-iqiyi-nasdaq-iq-stock-falls-45-heres-why-2026-11-09/

findings.finding: The ADS has traded below $1 for weeks (50-day moving average $0.96 on 11-09; spot $0.83 on 11-13). EDGAR shows no 6-K since 2026-08-19, so no Nasdaq bid-price deficiency notice has been disclosed yet. Management may address compliance on the call, for example with an ADS-ratio change. Such a step is often met with selling, and the sub-$1 status deters some institutional holders.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been disclosed, so there is nothing to price. The direction is ambiguous and the event may not come up at all inside the window.

findings.finding: Baidu, iQIYI's controlling shareholder, reports its Q3 2026 results on the same day, 2026-11-16 (date announced 2026-10-27). Baidu consolidates iQIYI, and its release and call on the same morning add a second information source and extra volatility to IQ inside the window. The sign is neutral.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Nov 2025, Baidu (Nov 18) and iQIYI (Nov 18) also reported on the same day; IQ moved about +2.75%.
findings.why_not_priced: The date is public, so the fact itself is priced. It matters for how large the move is, not its direction.

findings.finding: Q2 2026's GAAP net loss of RMB287.5M included a discrete enterprise income tax and interest charge of RMB193.6M at a mainland subsidiary. If it does not recur, Q3 GAAP net loss narrows mechanically against Q2's -$0.04 per ADS, which helps the GAAP headline against the -$0.01 consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 tax charge came with the wider net loss and a stock reaction of about -8%; headlines led with the 'wider net loss'.
findings.why_not_priced: The -$0.01 consensus (75% better than a year ago) probably already excludes the one-off, so this is likely largely priced. It is a below-the-line item with no path to guidance.

findings.finding: Balance-sheet strain: at 2026-06-30, cash plus short-term investments were RMB4.12bn against about RMB13.7bn of debt. That includes about RMB3.5bn current (RMB1.9bn short-term loans plus RMB1.6bn current portion of long-term loans), a current ratio of 0.45, and about RMB6.6bn of convertible notes; cash was down from RMB4.9bn four quarters earlier. On the other side, Q2 FCF was +RMB319.6M, a US$100M buyback is running (US$24.1M spent by 06-30), and a Hong Kong listing application is pending. The money is refinancing, not funding a ramp, so I sign it mildly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed directly. The March 2026 note repurchase-right event coincided with a corporate-developments release on 03-30 that the baseline matched at +6.3%, but that day also carried the buyback and HK listing news.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance sheet is public and the market cap of about $0.8bn already reflects leverage, so this is largely priced. A further cash drop in Q3 is the incremental risk the Finviz/Earnings Whispers preview flags.
findings.independence: Finviz/Earnings Whispers preview flags the cash decline from RMB4.9bn to RMB4.1bn: https://finviz.com/news/419195/iqiyis-ai-pivot-faces-its-breakeven-test-as-revenue-keeps-sliding

outside_window.finding: Pending Hong Kong dual primary listing (application confidentially filed, announced 2026-03-30). No timetable found; a listing or raise would land after the window.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Baseline reaction history median of 4.04% as the earnings base rate
rejected_candidates.detail: The sweep flagged it untrustworthy (it mixes non-earnings 6-Ks: 07-02, 03-30, 01-21, 12-03). I rebuilt it from confirmed releases only: Nov 2025 +2.75, Feb 2026 -3.39, May 2026 -1.77, Aug 2026 -8.13, median absolute about 3.1

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The tape (-13.6% in 5 days, at a 52-week low, crowded short) already reflects the weak drama slate. The mild positives, a low RMB bar and cost mix, cut against the run-up, while the name's habit of selling its prints agrees with it, so the net is balanced.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (proxy) and rule 7 (crowded short): Yunhe drama-share finding cut from -1.0 to -0.7. It is a broad third-party series, but the transmission to membership revenue is inference, and a 14-day short base shrinks the negative.
Rule 6 (bar): the RMB bar rests on my FX conversion of a USD consensus, so the bar-vs-run-rate finding is capped and cut from +0.8 to +0.5. Rule 1: confirmed prints were sold three times in four.
Rule 2 (one-off): the non-recurring Q2 tax charge is below the line with no path to guidance; cut from +0.3 to +0.1.
Rule 4 (financing): the money is refinancing, not funding a ramp, with FCF positive and a buyback running, so no distress verdict; cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 7: sub-$1 compliance overhang cut from -0.2 to -0.1 given the crowded short.

Lesson on reaction histories from the wrong events: rebuilt the base rate from four confirmed releases (median absolute about 3.1%, three of four down) instead of the baseline's 4.04%. abs_move stays at 6.0 because of 68% realised vol, the sub-$1 tick, the crowded short and Baidu reporting the same morning. p_up moved from 48 to 49 because the crowded-short squeeze and the low RMB bar offset the sell-the-print history more evenly once the negatives were shrunk.
Net: the findings sum is unchanged at +0.6 (the cuts happened to offset); the scaled number moved from -0.24 to -0.12.
